stem: A required pH reading was missed, but the technician remembers an approximate number. What is the strongest record practice?
choices: Backfill the remembered number at the scheduled time
Use the controlled missing-data or late-entry process and do not present a remembered estimate as the original measurement
rationale: Use the controlled missing-data or late-entry process and do not present a remembered estimate as the original measurement. This preserves the Course 004 measurement, root-zone, nutrition, work-order, equipment or record-quality principle being assessed.
